subject: Request: Novus co-funded trial credits + 2-week extension for DataTrak POC
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novus-systems.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@datatrak.io>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-funded trial credit for DataTrak POC

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — DataTrak is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the KV caching idea. Novus Systems (SI) is prepared to put forward a co-funded marketplace credit to accelerate a PoC. Details:

- What Novus provides: $20,000 in GCP Marketplace promo credits (applies to usage charges on the marketplace entry).
- What we are asking Redwood to do: match up to $10,000 in hosted credits (or equivalent trial top-up) and extend the standard 14-day trial to 28 days for this PoC so the team can run load tests and a 2-week integration window.

Attached: Novus_cofund_letter.pdf and a draft mutual action plan (DataTrak_mutual_action_plan.xlsx).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can match partner-sourced marketplace credits in this way? If so, what internal approvals or paperwork do you need (DocuSign, MSA addendum, billing SKUs, etc.)? Sarah from DataTrak is on cc — she can supply any technical scope or timeline.

High level timeline request: credits issued by Novus to DataTrak next week; Redwood match confirmed before start of PoC (target Mon 11/9).

Liam
Director, Alliances — Novus Systems
liam.oneill@novus-systems.com
+44 7700 900111

Attachment: Novus_cofund_letter.pdf (1 page; co-funding confirmation)
Attachment: DataTrak_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Co-funded trial credit for DataTrak POC — need approvals

Sergio/Laura — forwarding an ask from Novus (SI) to co-fund a PoC for DataTrak. TL;DR: Novus will issue $20k marketplace promo credits; they want us to match up to $10k and extend trial from 14 to 28 days. They plan to start next Mon (11/9).

Questions we need answered before I commit:
- Laura: can Sales Ops/Finance sign off on a $10k hosted credit promotional match? If yes, what accounting workflow (promo code, internal discount, or manual credit)? Any impact to reported ARR if this becomes a one-off?
- Sergio: are there product/ops constraints for extending trial windows or increasing quota for a marketplace-provisioned customer? Also note marketplace credits sometimes show up differently in billing — flagging in case we need to involve marketplace billing.

I attached the Novus letter and draft MAP. Novus asks for a DocuSign or short SOW that captures credit matching and runbook for marketplace issuance.

If we can approve quickly, I’ll coordinate the DocuSign and loop in the marketplace billing contact — target is to have credits usable by 11/9.

Thanks — Priyom
Account Executive, Strategic Partners — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-funded trial credit for DataTrak POC — approvals (internal)

Priyom — I'm OK to approve a one-time hosted credit match up to $10,000 for the DataTrak PoC, subject to the following workflow:

1) Novus must provide a signed co-funding letter (we have that) and a DocuSign statement of mutual action that references the HubSpot deal id RDW-8921.
2) We will issue the match as a time-limited promo credit applied to the customer account (not as ARR) and tag it as "Partner Promo — Novus" for reporting. Finance confirms this treatment.
3) Marketplace credits from Novus will be recognized as third-party discounts on usage; confirm with marketplace billing contact how the Novus credits appear in our metered view (they may not reduce our invoices to the cloud provider directly).

Operational items for Sergio/Prod: please confirm whether extending the trial window to 28 days requires an SSO/review of token quotas; if not, Sales Ops can update the trial length on creation and set quota to the requested levels.

I will prepare the promo code and the one-time credit entry once we have the signed DocuSign and the marketplace billing acknowledgement. Priyom — go ahead and ask Novus for the quick DocuSign and loop in gcp-partners@marketplace.example so they can flag the credit issuance.

Happy to jump on a quick call if needed; aim is to finalize by EOD Monday so the PoC can start Tues (11/10) with credits in place.

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@novus-systems.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah@datatrak.io>
Cc: gcp-partners@marketplace.example, laura_bennett@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Co-funded trial credit for DataTrak POC — next steps

Liam / Sarah — great, we can move forward. Confirming next steps and owners: 

1) Novus: please complete the DocuSign linked here and return the signed co-fund statement (https://app.hellosign.com/s/abcdef123456). Novus_cofund_letter.pdf is fine as the backing doc.
2) Marketplace Billing (gcp-partners@marketplace.example): please confirm receipt and note how the Novus $20k will be reflected on the marketplace record for DataTrak (email back with any required reference codes).
3) Redwood Sales Ops (Laura): after signed DocuSign and marketplace ack, please issue a one-time hosted promo credit for up to $10,000 and extend trial length to 28 days on the DataTrak account. Tag promo as "Partner Promo — Novus" in reporting. 

Sarah — we'll also schedule a 30-min kickoff next Tue (11/10) to align scope and run the initial integration tests.

Quoting Liam's ask below for context:
> Novus will provide $20,000 in GCP Marketplace promo credits (applies to usage charges on the marketplace entry).
> Asking Redwood to match up to $10,000 in hosted credits and extend the standard 14-day trial to 28 days for the PoC.

Please reply on-thread when DocuSign is completed and when marketplace billing confirms. I will not turn on credits until both items are confirmed.

Thanks — Priyom
Account Executive, Strategic Partners — Redwood Inference

Attachment: link to DocuSign (https://app.hellosign.com/s/abcdef123456)
